About.mainTitle: WE SUPPORT YOUR SUPPLY OF CERTIFIED FOOD PACKAGING!
About.history: CL INTERNATIONAL is strategically located in the Aix-en-Provence business hub. Founded in 1999 by Jimmy and Carina LIM, the company builds on over 25 years of international trade experience.
About.evolution: Specializing in sourcing and distributing food packaging and professional tableware, we select top manufacturing units in Asia to meet the needs of foodservice, snacking, and event professionals.
About.mission: Today, we deliver reliable, tailor-made supply that is 100% compliant with the strictest European environmental and food-safety regulations.
About.flexibility: A complete range of disposable, compostable, and reusable packaging adapted to takeaway and foodservice needs.

Expertise.headerTitle: Packaging ranges compliant with European standards

kraft.title: Paper & Kraft Range
kraft.desc: Cardboard and kraft paper packaging solutions dedicated to fast food, snacking, and pastry, combining mechanical strength with environmental responsibility.

pet.title: High-Clarity PET Range
pet.desc: Transparent containers designed to showcase cold dishes, salads, and desserts while ensuring optimal preservation.

cocktail.title: Cocktail & Reusable Range
cocktail.desc: Durable event tableware engineered to meet legal reuse mandates while maintaining a refined aesthetic.

items.products: Products: Reusable PP (polypropylene) cutlery, reusable PS cups, and plastic verrines.
items.durability: High Resistance: Tested and certified to withstand at least 20 commercial dishwasher cycles.
items.safety: Food Safety: Validated food-grade testing and guaranteed BPA-free formulation.

compliance.title: Quality Control & Regulatory Compliance
compliance.desc: Because food packaging regulations are demanding, we audit every factory and verify all certificates prior to shipment.

items.sanitary: Chemical Safety: Systematic verification of the absence of harmful substances (PFAS Free, BPA Free, REACH, POPs).
items.ecology: Sustainable Traceability: Verification of FSC, EUDR certificates, and TÜV compostability labels (Home & Industrial).
items.audit: Factory Inspection: Validation of mechanical tests (wash resistance, anti-fog) and pre-shipment quality control.

CompanyIntro.title: We support your success in international sourcing and global trade projects
CompanyIntro.p1: Located in the Aix-en-Provence business hub near Marseille, CL INTERNATIONAL has specialized in import-export and international sourcing since its founding in 1999 by Jimmy and Carina LIM.
CompanyIntro.p2: Backed by over 25 years of experience, the company supports clients in distributing and optimizing their purchases—particularly across Asia—through a strong partner network and a dedicated sourcing team.
CompanyIntro.p3: Our service is flexible and adaptable: generally from design to delivery, though we also handle one-off and modular requests. Over time, our services have expanded into many areas: packaging, textiles, timber logs, food products, furniture, perfumes, leather goods, industrial molds, and construction materials.
CompanyIntro.foundersCaption: Jimmy and Carina LIM, founders of CL INTERNATIONAL
CompanyIntro.meetingCaption: Project coordination and team discussions at CL INTERNATIONAL
CompanyIntro.teamTitle: Your partner for a profitable supply chain
CompanyIntro.teamP1: CL INTERNATIONAL was founded in 1999 by Jimmy and Carina LIM. An enterprising, versatile duo who first built successful ventures across different fields (hospitality, sales, and more) before focusing on their core passion: international trade.
CompanyIntro.teamP2: Through their backgrounds, Carina and Jimmy embody the meeting of two countries, China and Sweden, and two continents: Europe and Asia.
CompanyIntro.teamP3: A distinctive strength of CL INTERNATIONAL is its family-driven spirit involving other members of the LIM family. Since 2011, their son David has been part of the journey, first as sales manager and now as commercial director. Then, in 2019, Jérôme LIM joined the team as head of financial management and development, alongside Aurélie, as well as Kathaline and Lisa who also contribute to the extended CL INTERNATIONAL family.
CompanyIntro.teamCaption: From left to right: Aurélie, Jérôme, Carina, Jimmy and David

Services.title: Our service offerings
Services.intro: We build tailor-made purchasing and sourcing solutions through a structured five-step service process.

contact.title: Initial contact
contact.description: This foundational first step shapes and guides how the project is set up and delivered. Through an in-person meeting and/or phone call, we get to know each other to establish the conditions for a constructive collaboration. We introduce our company, approach, working methods, expertise, and track record, then listen to and analyze your needs to determine the most suitable services.

audit.title: Audit
audit.description: At this stage, we begin actively proposing solutions by bringing methodology and advice to support the successful execution of your project, analyzing and addressing its core dimensions:
technicalItems: Review of specifications and/or technical datasheets (with the option to define them together)
Determination of sales terms: target prices and Incoterms (entry and exit points)
legalItems: Conditions for future sale on the target market (customs duties, product certification, and approvals)

sourcing.title: Sourcing
sourcing.description: Once your needs are clarified and defined, we identify a supplier panel and conduct a thorough evaluation to select the partner whose offer best matches your requirements—focusing on reliability, professionalism, efficiency, ethics, and value for money—backed by in-depth offer verification and sample sourcing and analysis for final validation with you.

negotiation.title: Negotiation
negotiation.description: This step is key to supporting your sourcing process in its most cost-effective form, addressing lead times, pricing, and guarantees in your best interest. We handle negotiations in close collaboration with you, keep you updated with key information as discussions progress, secure contractual commitments ensuring full compliance between samples and the final product, and define the most suitable shipping method.

followup.title: Follow-up
followup.description: At this stage, we focus on product quality and compliance with technical, environmental, and social standards. We arrange expert quality inspections, coordinate all logistics aspects to facilitate and secure import and export operations, and ensure strict management of orders, delivery schedules, and international payments.
